verdict.rationale: Cognee supports ingesting text/files/URLs and dataset-level deletion (single item, full dataset, or full cleanup) via .remember and .forget, and .improve enriches an existing graph after ingestion, which implies some batch-like processing, but there is no explicit documentation of bulk/batch APIs (e.g., submitting many items in one call, batch job status, or bulk edit operations) — missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch ingestion or deletion API, evidence of throughput/performance at scale, and independent confirmation of bulk operation support beyond single-call convenience wrappers.
